Now at this time red had entered into a codependent orbit (highschool relationship, but for fats) with another celestial body who also happened to be on this band trip, let's call him wolf. Now mostly everyone had been seated on the plane and was either content with their seats, or did not give a shit because most of us were just gonna nap during the flight. But not red, oh no. Return to me and me saxophone boys, the three of us would actually spend a good part of band making jokes about red and her antics, and we were making such jokes as we waited for the plane to finish boarding. All of a sudden, I hear a thumping sound approaching from behind me on the aisle. I turn to look into the aisle and sure enough, red is standing there red faced with tear marks down her puffy cheeks. "Pugatlas, can you swap seats with me?" she asked me because we had been in a musical the year before and she thought I considered her a friend I guess, I really didn't. Now you must understand that I'm not very good with children, and I don't like to make scenes in public, so I'm at a crossroads in my mind: I could forfeit my seat and avoid further tears, or I could stand my ground and open a new water park while also ending the water crisis with the ensuing torrent.
